episodes.title: The Mind of Manson: A Profiler’s Perspective Full Documentary 2007
episodes.description:
The Mind of Manson: A Profiler’s Perspective (2007)

Go inside the mind of America's most infamous cult leader. In this compelling 2007 special, Dateline NBC’s Keith Morrison joins forces with legendary former FBI criminal profiler Candice DeLong to dissect the psychology of Charles Manson.

Twenty years after NBC News first conducted its groundbreaking prison interview with Manson in 1987, Morrison and DeLong reexamine the archival footage. DeLong uses her expertise as a federal profiler to break down Manson’s erratic rants, exposing his pathological need for control, history of rejection, and the precise psychological manipulation tactics he used to command the Manson Family.
